title: Fractal budget prober and quant presets
author: Maya Ortiz
description: Implements a tenant-aware budget probing utility (fractal budget prober) plus a lightweight quant-profile registrar and CLI to expose default batching/caching/quantization recommendations. Motivation: customers repeatedly ask for safe, automated defaults that balance 99th percentile latency and unit cost without manual tuning. This change introduces a probing mode that performs space-efficient fractal sampling of request shapes to build a compact tenant signature, a quant-profile snapshot format (+registrar service), and a new redwoodctl econ-init command that bootstraps tenant defaults into the defaults store. The design goals were: 1) non-disruptive rollout (read-only probing + staged apply), 2) inexpensive probes (sub-1% overhead for steady traffic via fractal sampling and lightweight KV hints), 3) reproducible quant snapshots for safe rollbacks. The PR contains: CLI (redwoodctl econ-init + dry-run), an agent that emits the tenant signature and probes to a background worker, a registrar API + migration for quant presets (schema v2), default templates for batching/caching/quant for small/medium/large latency-sensitive workloads, end-to-end simulator for verifying unit economics (synth workloads) and a migration plan to backfill existing tenants with conservative defaults. Rollout plan: enable probe-only for 2 weeks in canary, collect telemetry, then enable auto-apply for tenants with low-variance signatures. Important notes: registrar stores only quant metadata (no model weights), probing respects tenant privacy controls and rate limits.

feat(cli): redwoodctl econ-init and econ-dryrun output
feat(registrar): quant-profile snapshot schema v2 and registrar service

Priya Nair: Please ensure quant snapshot schema is backwards compatible with v1. Noted: migration uses v1->v2 adapter for reads.

release_notes: Added a tenant budget probing agent (fractal sampling) and econ-init CLI to bootstrap safe batching/caching/quant defaults. Introduced quant-profile snapshot schema v2 and registrar service. Defaults are conservative by default and rollout is probe-only unless opted into auto-apply.
